chapterInfo.content:
10
Atɛn tenenee ho mpaebɔ
1 # Dwom 44.24 AWURADE, adɛn nti na wogyina akyirikyiri,
na wode wo ho hunta ahokyere berɛ mu?
2Ɔbɔnefoɔ ahantan nti ɛmma mmɔborɔni ho hyehye no,
wɔde wɔn atirimpɔ a wɔabɔ no kye wɔn.
3Na ɔbɔnefoɔ hoahoa ne ho ade a ne kra kɔn dɔ ho,
na omimfoɔ ka abususɛm yi AWURADE ahi.
4Ɔbɔnefoɔ dwa n’anomu ka sɛ: Hwee mfa ne ho.
Onyankopɔn bi nni baabi! n’adwene nyinaa ne no.
5 # Amos 6.3 N’akwan yere hɔ pintinn daa nyinaa.
W’atemmudeɛ asɔre n’ani so kɔ akyirikyiri,
ɔmfa n’ahohiahiafoɔ nyinaa nyɛ ahuro.
6 # Dwom 73.4-8 Ɔse no n’akomam sɛ: Merenhinhim da,
daa nyinaa merenhyia amaneɛ biara.
7 # Rom 3.14 Nnome, nkontomposɛm ne amimdie ahyɛ n’anomu ma,
na ɔhaw ne mmusuo hyɛ ne tɛkyerɛma ase.
8Ɔtetɛ nsumaeɛ mu,
ɔdi deɛ ɔnyɛɛ hwee no awu kokoam,
ɔwɔ awiɛmfoɔ ho ani.
9 # Dwom 17.12 Ɔtɛ kokoam sɛ gyata wɔ ne bɔn mu,
ɔtɛ sɛ ne nsa bɛka mmɔborɔni
ne nsa ka mmɔborɔni no twe no ba n’afidie mu.
10Ɔkoto, ɔdɛɛdɛɛ,
na awiɛmfoɔ akɔka ne nsa.
11 # Dwom 94.7 Ɔse no n’akomam sɛ: Nyankopɔn werɛ afi,
ɔde n’ani ahunta ɔrenhunu ara da.
12Ao, AWURADE sɔre, ɛ! Ao, Onyankopɔn, ma wo nsa so.
Mma wo werɛ mmfiri amanehunufoɔ.
13Adɛn nti na ɔbɔnefoɔ yi Onyankopɔn ahi
ka no n’akomam sɛ: Worentwe m’aso?
14 # Dwom 68.5; Eks 22.22 Wohunu, ɛfiri sɛ wo na wohwɛ ɔhaw ne awerɛhoɔ,
sɛ wode bɛsie wo nsam.
Wo nsa na ɔbrɛfoɔ de hyɛ,
awisiaa boafoɔ ne wo ara.
15 # Dwom 37.10; 36 Bubu abɔnefoɔ basa,
na di obusuyɛfoɔ bɔne akyi kɔsi sɛ worenhunu bio.
16 # Dwom 99.1 AWURADE ne hene daa daa,
amanaman ayera afiri n’asase so.
17AWURADE, wobɛtie deɛ ahobrɛasefoɔ pɛ,
woahyɛ wɔn akoma den, woama w’aso aba so
18sɛ wobɛdi awisiaa ne deɛ wɔhyɛ no soɔ no asɛm,
na ɔdasani a ɔfiri asase mu no anhunahuna bio.

AWURADE, adɛn nti na wogyina akyirikyiri,
na wode wo ho hunta ahokyere berɛ mu?
Ɔbɔnefoɔ ahantan nti ɛmma mmɔborɔni ho hyehye no,
wɔde wɔn atirimpɔ a wɔabɔ no kye wɔn.
Na ɔbɔnefoɔ hoahoa ne ho ade a ne kra kɔn dɔ ho,
na omimfoɔ ka abususɛm yi AWURADE ahi.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ dwa n’anomu ka sɛ: Hwee mfa ne ho.
Onyankopɔn bi nni baabi! n’adwene nyinaa ne no.
N’akwan yere hɔ pintinn daa nyinaa.
W’atemmudeɛ asɔre n’ani so kɔ akyirikyiri,
ɔmfa n’ahohiahiafoɔ nyinaa nyɛ ahuro.
Ɔse no n’akomam sɛ: Merenhinhim da,
daa nyinaa merenhyia amaneɛ biara.
Nnome, nkontomposɛm ne amimdie ahyɛ n’anomu ma,
na ɔhaw ne mmusuo hyɛ ne tɛkyerɛma ase.
Ɔtetɛ nsumaeɛ mu,
ɔdi deɛ ɔnyɛɛ hwee no awu kokoam,
ɔwɔ awiɛmfoɔ ho ani.
Ɔtɛ kokoam sɛ gyata wɔ ne bɔn mu,
ɔtɛ sɛ ne nsa bɛka mmɔborɔni
ne nsa ka mmɔborɔni no twe no ba n’afidie mu.
Ɔkoto, ɔdɛɛdɛɛ,
na awiɛmfoɔ akɔka ne nsa.
Ɔse no n’akomam sɛ: Nyankopɔn werɛ afi,
ɔde n’ani ahunta ɔrenhunu ara da.
Ao, AWURADE sɔre, ɛ! Ao, Onyankopɔn, ma wo nsa so.
Mma wo werɛ mmfiri amanehunufoɔ.
Adɛn nti na ɔbɔnefoɔ yi Onyankopɔn ahi
ka no n’akomam sɛ: Worentwe m’aso?
Wohunu, ɛfiri sɛ wo na wohwɛ ɔhaw ne awerɛhoɔ,
sɛ wode bɛsie wo nsam.
Wo nsa na ɔbrɛfoɔ de hyɛ,
awisiaa boafoɔ ne wo ara.
Bubu abɔnefoɔ basa,
na di obusuyɛfoɔ bɔne akyi kɔsi sɛ worenhunu bio.
AWURADE ne hene daa daa,
amanaman ayera afiri n’asase so.
AWURADE, wobɛtie deɛ ahobrɛasefoɔ pɛ,
woahyɛ wɔn akoma den, woama w’aso aba so
sɛ wobɛdi awisiaa ne deɛ wɔhyɛ no soɔ no asɛm,
na ɔdasani a ɔfiri asase mu no anhunahuna bio.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
